gloss: leisure time; spare time; free time

definitions.gloss: leisure time; spare time; free time
definitions.explanation: Time free from work or obligations, available for rest and recreation. A somewhat formal word compared to {暇|ひま} or {自由時間|じゆうじかん}.

examples.japanese: {余暇|よか}には{読書|どくしょ}をして{過|す}ごしている。
examples.english: I spend my free time reading.

examples.japanese: {仕事|しごと}が{忙|いそが}しすぎて{余暇|よか}を{過|す}ごす{時間|じかん}がほとんどない。
examples.english: I'm so busy with work that I barely have any leisure time.

notes:
USAGE:
{余暇|よか} is a somewhat formal or literary word for free time. It is commonly used in discussions of work-life balance, lifestyle, and recreation. In casual conversation, {暇|ひま} or {自由|じゆう}{時間|じかん} is more natural.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {余暇|よか}を{過|す}ごす (to spend leisure time)
- {余暇|よか}を{楽|たの}しむ (to enjoy leisure time)
- {余暇|よか}{活動|かつどう} (leisure activities)
- {余暇|よか}の{使|つか}い{方|かた} (how to spend free time)

COMPARISON:
- {暇|ひま} — free time (casual, everyday)
- {余暇|よか} — leisure time (formal, often in writing)
- {自由|じゆう}{時間|じかん} — free time (neutral, descriptive)
